title: Unanimity of the OR function
statement: For every natural number $n>0$, the OR function on sign vectors of length $n$, which returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate is $1$ and returns $-1$ otherwise, returns $1$ on the all-$1$ input and $-1$ on the all-$-1$ input.
